svg.aria-label: Software Engineer at BlendLab · Remote, May 2025 – Nov 2025. Built AI-powered products end to end, with NestJS services and Flutter apps. Subscriptions and payments with Stripe: plans, billing and webhooks. RAG semantic search with Pinecone, wired into backend services. Faster map features through pre-computation and caching. Projects: BunudAI, Tesaa, PinRose.
